findings.message:
Task acceptance not fulfilled: the review found that the candidate does not satisfy source issue #8. Change the candidate so it satisfies everything the issue requires; the reviewer's acceptance evidence:
- Adds authorizationVersion to UserRecord, AgentTokenRecord, and AccessTokenClaims; verifyAccessToken rejects tokens when the stored version differs or the user is missing (src/token_service.ts:200-221).
- Bumps the version on administrator/scope changes, password set/clear, passkey removal, logout, and agent-token deletion (src/auth_store.ts:769-805, 985-990, 1319-1332; src/passport.ts:1264-1267).
- Adds an end-to-end demotion test that checks a former administrator's bearer token against /api/auth/session/me and asserts 401 after demotion (tests/worker_runtime.mjs:948-981).
- Acceptance gap: access-token max lifetime remains 30 days (accessTokenMaxTtlMs in src/auth_config.ts:120), and README.md:147-150 only tells consumers to introspect for revocation-sensitive requests; a consumer that validates JWTs alone still accepts a demoted or deleted administrator token until expiry, so the required lifetime reduction fallback was not implemented.

summary: No introduced code defects found; the authorization-version claims, stale-token checks, version bumps, and demotion test are coherent. Task acceptance is not fully met because the 30-day access-token lifetime was not reduced even though consumers that only validate JWTs do not enforce the new version.
